desc:
⚔️ WELCOME TO ANIME DICE FIGHTER! 🎲

🎲 Roll dice endlessly to collect the rarest and most powerful Anime Fighters!

⚔️ FIGHT enemies to earn Gold and XP!
🍀Buy better dice to increase your luck and unlock stronger Fighters!
🌟 Collect rare Anime Fighters and deal massive damage!
📜 Complete quests to earn rewards and progress!
🌍 Unlock new worlds with stronger enemies and even better Fighters!
🐉 Unlock awesome mounts to explore the worlds!

🎲 Keep rolling, boost your Luck, and build the ultimate Anime Fighter team!

🔥 Can you become the strongest player in Anime Dice Fighter?
